name: @hasna/apps
description: Hasna's public OSS apps monorepo — @hasna/* packages built and published from apps/ (per-app CLIs and SDKs).

scripts.check: bun run check:names && bun run check:dep-direction && bun run check:secrets && bun run check:manifests && bun run check:publish-guard && bun run check:deploy-lanes && bun run test:standard && bun run check:frozen-locks
scripts.check:deploy-lanes: bun tooling/ci/check-deploy-lanes.ts && bun tooling/ci/check-todos-deploy.ts --self-test && bun tooling/ci/check-todos-deploy.ts
scripts.test:suites: bun run test:versioning && bun run test:standard
scripts.prepare:ordered: bun run --filter @hasna/attachments build && bun run --filter @hasna/loops build && bun run --filter @hasna/mementos build && bun run --filter @hasna/skills build && bun run --filter @hasna/connectors postinstall && bun run --filter @hasna/slides postinstall
